title: It Comes Back Black
subject: a London renter at war with a black mould patch on her bathroom ceiling that returns every three weeks no matter how much bleach she uses, until the landlord finally sends someone to fix the extractor fan
caption: Industrial dark-pop, mid-2020s operatic dance-pop with industrial edges. Distorted four-on-the-floor kick with clanging metallic percussion; a gritty analog synth bass; a fast harpsichord-like synth arpeggio; staccato string stabs on the chorus. Dark glossy dance mix, dry close verses, wide chorus. Female mezzo with low dramatic verses rising to a belted operatic chorus. 122 BPM, D minor. Theatrical, menacing and secretly funny. No trap beat, no autotune, no ballad section, no acoustic guitar, no EDM festival drop.
lyrics:
[Intro - metallic hits, synth arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
Above the bath, a little cloud
Grey at first, then shouting loud
I scrub it clean on Sunday night
By Thursday it is back in sight

[Pre-Chorus]
Rubber gloves up to the wrist
Bleach and a sponge in my fist

[Chorus]
It comes back black, it comes back black
I wipe it off, it wipes me back
Three weeks of peace, then the corner cracks
Oh, it comes back black

[Verse 2]
I wrote the landlord twice in May
He said to open windows every day
It's raining and the fan is dead
It hums a note and spins in my head

[Chorus]
It comes back black, it comes back black
Then a man with a ladder, toolbox on his back
He fits a fan that finally works
And the black goes back

[Outro - strings and kick, then one clang]
White ceiling, white tile
Let me look at it a while
